title: Over-Managing the Trade
hook: Activity is not the same as management.

launchpad.outcome: Feel the pull of micromanagement, then compare what was planned with what was done.
launchpad.missionQuestion: What plan am I actually trading?

slides.title: Planned, rule-based or unplanned?

items.text: Holding to the fixed target the plan set.
Trailing the stop because the plan’s HL condition triggered.
Moving the stop because the candle looked scary.
Taking the partial the plan scheduled at +30.
Adding a contract because it’s “clearly going”.
Moving the target because you’re greedy.

slides.punch: SOMETIMES THE BEST MANAGEMENT DECISION IS TO STOP TOUCHING THINGS.

slides.quote: Not every touch is bad. Unplanned touching is.

slides.modelAnswer: Moving the stop, the target and the size again and again, taking random partials and closing manually, until the trade no longer resembles the plan I locked.

remember: Sometimes the best management decision is to stop touching things.
